findings.title: C84's lands still get full stencil apertures although C84 is now hand-fitted after both reflows

evidence.reference: C84 MA25V470M8x10 C46550466, footprint M3_MA_8x10, F.Cu (27.5, 78.5) rotation 90; pad 1 VLOGIC (27.5, 81.75), pad 2 GND (27.5, 75.25), lands 3.5 x 1.7 mm

measured.paste_flashes: aperture D36 'R,1.700000X3.500000' flashed at X27.5 Y-81.75 and X27.5 Y-75.25 = 100 % of both lands (2 of the 245 F.Paste flashes)
measured.upload_state: C84 absent from m3_bom_jlc.csv and m3_cpl_jlc.csv; owner BOM row "manual, after both reflow passes"
measured.order_text: ORDERING 8.2: "Use the supplied paste apertures exactly, with no aperture optimisation or added openings" and "C84 absent from both passes"
measured.paste_volume: 5.95 mm^2 x 0.10-0.12 mm stencil = 0.60-0.71 mm^3 per land (Calculation), reflowed bare on the top (last) pass (Inference)

findings.impact: Bounded: JLC prints and reflows paste on two bare lands, so C84 arrives on tinned domes that neither the manual-fit operation nor the first-article seating/height check mentions, and JLC may query paste at a site with no placement. No electrical effect; the D-R18-09 move itself is correct.
findings.concrete_fix: Now (docs only): state in ORDERING 8.2 and the order remark that the two C84 apertures are kept on purpose (lands pre-tinned) or ask JLC to block them, and require the manual operation to reflow both lands fully and check standoff and tilt. If the board is rebuilt for another reason: drop F.Paste from the M3_MA_8x10 pads in the generator and give paste_check the MANUAL_FIT exemption.
